basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: Keeps two clocks: when something was true in the business and when the company recorded it.
Corrects by appending a new recorded snapshot, so earlier answers can be reproduced.
Uses half-open validity intervals and rejects overlaps within one scope.

may: Answer what was valid at a time as recorded at another time.
Return unknown before the first receipt.
mustNot: Rewrite or delete an earlier recorded view.
Return false when the honest answer is insufficient context.
Choose silently between two timelines for the same scope.
requiresHuman: Deciding which of two conflicting timelines is authoritative.
Creating a new scope when meaning changes.

considerations: History that can be rewritten lets mistakes about people disappear; append-only records keep accountability.
Old attribution stays visible, so people are judged by what was known at the time.
affectedParties: Employees and contractors whose actions or data appear in company records
Customers, suppliers and partners named in company records
Auditors, regulators and courts that rely on the record later

owners.steward: Each domain owner owns the history of its facts; the host operator owns the recorded-time ledger.
masterSystems: Bitemporal store or ledger of the host

properties.reason: Institutional or informational subject: it has no physical body to measure.

items: A history record carries validFrom/validTo and a recorded sequence for one scope.
Retroactive edits that change past reports.
Overlapping validity making two values current at once.
Any company fact that changes over time and is reported on later.

sections.whatItIs: A companion contract for a Company Dimension that records when facts were valid in the business and when the company recorded them, keeps earlier recorded views reproducible, and binds schemas and domain states to time.

sources.title: Research record EM-XCT-04: independent provider studies, audits and reconciled findings
sources.note: Evidence behind the release; claims in the card trace to it.
